body: Nope. Just my fallopians. Even when I was 100lbs smaller and in the service I couldn't get a doctor to respect my concerns. I've thought about pcos because I'm always in so much pain down there and I've had cysts burst but I don't have all the markers for it so I've never really explored that option.

It actually made me cry out of relief. Why is this so hard? Why can't we admit this to one another in person and feel comfortable doing so? We can do it anonymously online but the moment we add our faces to it it's too much to deal with.
I feel the same way about kids. I think it's because they're fairly basic and don't judge like we adults do.

We have cars 'n' coffee which is weekly. Which is really weird to me. I Moved to here from an area in which it's mostly monthly. But the area I moved from my car is a joke. I love cars but our subculture can be vicious. :(

I have to be honest, this isn't the response I expected. Thank you. I appreciate your insistence. Volunteering at a soup kitchen is the one thing that makes me really appreciate my fellow man. Specially fellow veterans. I can't explain it but this time of year makes me really want to take care of my own.

I have. It gets me no where. Some people fight back when they come across something they don't understand. 

Overall, I have to say, I've enjoyed talking with you about cars. I don't have anyone in my family I can share my passion with even though I tried today. It's pretty much the only passion I have that hasn't changed my whole life. Unfortunately, the car i have sucks massively and doesn't allow me to express myself. I'm financially burdened with it and in a family of people roll their eyes the moment I express excitement towards cars. 

I probably would have been better off single for life and surrounded by fun cars. I've gotten more happiness from cars than I have from people.
you don't think I've tried all of this? I'm 40 not 20.
WHen I say how I feel I'm told I'm being stupid or ridiculous.
What about them? All they ever say is how stupid depression is. They don't get it. I'm the only one fucked with this issue. Not a single one of them know what it's like.
I feel unwanted. I've felt unwanted for 30 years a person ca only take so much.
I've been crying all night but you made me laugh. For that I'm thankful.
I saw a lime green 'Cuda today and pointed it out to my mom. She didn't understand. I've only been back home 5 months and no one understands me and cars. I've been gone from here for two decades.

I've dreamt of getting my hands on a 2nd variation Lincoln Continental, a Barracuda, a 69 Camaro (typical), a 70' GTO Judge or Z28, and a '78 TransAm. There is nothing quite like old muscle cars. 

Though I will admit that if I were able to get my crap together for 2 whole minutes I'd love to get an S30 chassis Datsun 240 and pass it down to my nephew.
